New category or subcategory

How projects which are no longer maintained can be handled?

One needs to be careful with removing projects, some inactive projects may be feature complete and still working without any new commits. Other projects, like many Markdown-based projects such as skills, may be not functional from the beginning despite new commits being added (possibly by repo management bots alone), since LLMs tend to fail at follow
